reason: The hypothesis directly restates the exact compositional strategy and predicted outcome already demonstrated in P13, P22, P24, and P27, where reducing Hf and Ta in HfNbTaTiZr led to lower density and maintained strength; applying this to HfMoTaTiZr is a trivial substitution of one known system for another with no new mechanism or integration of conflicting evidence.
copied_elements: Reducing Hf content to lower density
Increasing Ti content to compensate and maintain strength
Ti or Zr addition decreases density and elevated-temperature strength (P6, P21)
Decreasing Hf increases strength (P13, P22, P27)
Hf0.25NbTa0.25TiZr composition achieves low density and similar strength (P24, P27)
Single BCC solid solution maintained for strengthening
Lattice distortion and solid-solution strengthening as mechanism
